items.title: Personal: restarts ask less
items.detail: Personal: restarts no longer ask about text the page restores itself; the first restart after this update still asks once.

items.title: Surface icons
items.detail: Untagged Surfaces show a neutral surface icon instead of an empty square, and a Surface on another host shows that host as text after its title.

limits: Surface icons show a type only for Surfaces whose author says what they are.
